zh: 装货不会消耗卡车，每件货物的查询彼此独立：只需找到容量严格大于重量的最小容量，再在这个容量的卡车里取最小下标。
把卡车按容量排序，每个容量只保留最小的原下标，之后每次查询就是一次二分。
把（容量, 下标）排序后，二分出第一个容量大于重量的位置：同容量中排在最前的就是最小下标；找不到时输出 −1。
en: Loading does not use up a truck and packages are independent: find the smallest capacity strictly greater than the weight, then the smallest index among trucks with that capacity.
Sort trucks by capacity and keep only the smallest original index for each capacity; every query is then one binary search.
After sorting (capacity, index) pairs, binary search the first entry whose capacity exceeds the weight; the first entry of that capacity has the smallest index. Print −1 when there is none.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort by capacity, keep the smallest index for each capacity, and binary search for the first capacity strictly greater than the weight.

## Proof of correctness

Binary search skips every capacity that is not large enough, so the first remaining capacity is exactly the minimum usable capacity; the stored smallest index resolves ties within that capacity and nothing else. Independent queries do not modify the structure, which matches the rule that trucks can be reused.

## Complexity

O(n log n+m log n) time and O(n+m) space.
